svg.aria-label: Bench test mockup: an ESP32-S3-Zero with USB-C to a computer, jumper wires from 5V to Vin, GND to GND, GP2 to DIN, GP3 to BCLK and GP4 to LRC on a MAX98357A, and a small speaker on the MAX98357A's screw terminal.
svg.text: Five jumper wires, powered from the computer. Nothing touches the KALLSUP yet.
top view, USB-C to the left
Illustration. Board outlines to scale; pin order from the Waveshare and Adafruit pinouts.
